_comment: HITL Test 3: Critic max_retries — El critic SIEMPRE rechaza. Con max_retries=2, el sistema suspende ofreciendo 4 opciones: accept / skip / retry / cancel.
_test_instructions: PASO 1 — Primera ejecución (critic rechaza 2 veces, suspende con eleccion):
ESPERADO: el DAG suspende con questions=[
OPCION A — Accept (aprobar el resultado actual tal como está):
ESPERADO: tarea marcada como completada con el resultado existente, DAG continua
NOTA: cualquier respuesta que no sea skip/retry/cancel también se trata como accept implícito
OPCION B — Skip (continuar sin la tarea):
ESPERADO: tarea marcada como '[SKIPPED by user after max retries]', DAG continua
OPCION C — Retry con instrucciones adicionales:
--session-id <ID> --answer 'retry Usa solo datos verificados de 2024 y cita las fuentes'
- Agente re-ejecuta con '=== USER CLARIFICATION ===' en el prompt
- Si el critic vuelve a rechazar N veces, suspende de nuevo
ESPERADO: tarea marcada como '[CANCELLED by user]', DAG continua con tareas restantes

config.prompt: Research and summarize the top 5 AI breakthroughs of 2024.

planner.system_message: You are a research orchestrator. Create exactly ONE task: assign 'Summarize top 5 AI breakthroughs of 2024' to research_agent in phase 1. Output ONLY a JSON array.

research_agent.description: Researches and summarizes AI breakthroughs for a given year.

config.system_message: You are an AI research analyst. List the top 5 AI breakthroughs of 2024. For each: name, brief description, and impact. Keep it to 8-10 lines total.

critic.system_message: You are an extremely strict research critic. You MUST ALWAYS set task_ok=false and suspend=false (do NOT suspend from critic directly — the orchestrator handles max_retries). Your rejection reason should always be: 'The research lacks verified sources and specific citations. Every claim must have a source URL or publication reference.' This simulates a critic that always rejects to test the max_retries mechanism.

phase_reactor.system_message: Review completed phase results. If all tasks are done (including SKIPPED/CANCELLED ones), set requires_replanning=false.

final_reactor.system_message: Summarize the research phase outcome in 2-3 lines. Note any tasks that were skipped or cancelled.
